title: concept_battery source file v1 (A2) -- per-concept YAML under data/concepts/
description: Not an envelope artifact: A2's identity is a content hash of the data/concepts/ file set (§2.2, §3.4). This schema validates one per-concept source file. ED-8: per-language status distinguishes 'complete' (probes + researcher-authored negative controls, usable for sensitivity) from 'probes_only' (probes exist but matching negatives do not yet -- descriptive use only, never dropped). ED-9: census_terms are researcher-authored scientific content (same authorship policy as ED-8), with one mechanical carve-out -- English terms may be derived from concept_id (origin: 'concept_id'). census_terms presence is orthogonal to status. ED-10: two negative instruments, never conflated -- word_absent (concept-present, term-absent; the sensitivity instrument that governs status) and concept_absent (unrelated baseline text; the specificity-denominator instrument, orthogonal to status like census_terms). GENERAL_TEXT-style baselines belong in concept_absent, never word_absent.

word_absent.description: ED-10: concept-PRESENT, term-absent contexts only (the sensitivity instrument). MUST NOT contain unrelated baseline text -- that belongs in concept_absent.

concept_absent.description: ED-10: unrelated baseline text (the specificity-denominator instrument). Orthogonal to status, like census_terms.

census_terms.description: ED-9: researcher-authored (except English, which MAY be mechanically derived from concept_id, origin: 'concept_id'). Empty is valid -- a language with probes but no census_terms yet is measured as census status 'no_terms', not dropped.
